SRC-351:R001.text: A foreign protocol command is refused with a typed FOREIGN_PROTOCOL_COMMAND that names the protocol owner, the full invocation and the route to run instead, and is never refused as a bare unknown command.

SRC-351:R002.text: The refusal names the owning protocol, the exact requested command, and carries next_action guidance, so the caller cannot read it as a typo.

SRC-351:R003.text: SAIPEN verbs and shortcuts (cc, continue, next, status) remain SAIPEN-owned and unaffected by foreign-protocol routing.
